channel.title: EMFLS Studio Journal
channel.description: Independent field guides covering photography lighting, editorial design systems, and studio workflow craft.

item.title: CRI, TLCI, and TM-30 Metrics for Evaluating Continuous Studio LED Panels
item.description: Evaluate continuous LED studio panels using CRI Ra, saturated red R9, television TLCI, and IES TM-30 color vector graphics to eliminate camera skin-tone shifts.

item.title: Diagnosing Ground Loops, USB Isolators, and Balanced Line Interconnects in Desktop Audio
item.description: Trace 50Hz and 60Hz mains hum, high-frequency USB packet buzz, and ground loop paths across studio monitors, USB audio interfaces, and balanced TRS lines.

item.title: Optical Alignment, Bounding-Box Padding, and Visual Weight for System Icons
item.description: Align asymmetrical UI icons inside 24px grids by balancing geometric bounding boxes against visual mass, optical padding, and keyline surface areas.

item.title: Softbox Distance, Feathering, and Inverse-Square Falloff in Small Studios
item.description: Control portrait background brightness and shadow transition in a 3-metre room by measuring softbox distance, inverse-square falloff stops, and feather angles.

item.title: Window Light Direction, Diffusion, and Fill Angles for Small Rooms
item.description: Set up portraits in a small room by measuring window feathering angles, checking sheer curtain light loss, and setting white foam-core fill distance.

item.title: Using Spacing Tokens and Grouping Ratios to Clarify Complex Pages
item.description: Use a 4 px spacing grid, 8 px heading gaps, and 32 px section gaps to clarify dense documentation and verify the hierarchy at narrow widths.

item.title: Building Accessible Light and Dark Color Palettes with Luminance Ratios
item.description: Calculate WCAG luminance ratios for light and dark surfaces, then build three readable ink levels and verify muted borders against adjacent colors.

item.title: Controlling Specular Reflections and Soft Shadows on Tabletop Surfaces
item.description: Use measured scrim angles, black card spacing, and shadow edge widths to control highlights on matte ceramic, brushed metal, and clear glass.

item.title: Designing Crisp Technical SVG Diagrams with Consistent Stroke and Grid Rules
item.description: Use a 40-unit SVG grid, a three-weight stroke hierarchy, measured arrowheads, and 4.5:1 label contrast to keep technical diagrams readable on mobile.

item.title: Reducing First Reflections and Flutter Echo in Small Desk Rooms
item.description: Map first reflections, size a porous panel’s air gap, and test desk bounce and flutter echo with measured path lengths and before-and-after recordings.

item.title: Structuring Multi-Column Editorial Layouts That Scale Cleanly to 320px
item.description: Build a CSS editorial grid that fits 320 px, adds columns at measured widths, keeps the reading header sticky, and contains horizontal overflow.

item.title: Dynamic Range Recovery in 14-Bit RAW Files Compared to In-Camera JPEG
item.description: Measure highlight headroom in one-third-stop steps, compare 14-bit RAW and 8-bit JPEG, and use a shadow texture test to set a studio exposure limit.

item.title: sRGB, Display P3, and CMYK: Preventing Color Shifts Across Devices
item.description: Locate sRGB clipping in a Display P3 ramp, test CSS fallbacks on two displays, and use measured color differences to approve a matte paper proof.

item.title: Practical Date-First File Naming and Folder Trees for Creative Assets
item.description: Use date-first names, fixed-width sequences, read-only masters, and export folders to reach zero duplicate paths and trace each delivery to its source.

item.title: Setting Desk Monitor Brightness and Bias Lighting for Accurate Color Work
item.description: Set your monitor to 100–120 cd/m² and measure neutral D65 bias lighting at about 10% of screen white for more consistent shadow judgments.

item.title: Choosing Modular Type Scales, Line Height, and Measure for Long-Form Reading
item.description: Set heading ratios from 1.200 to 1.333, tune body measure to 60 to 72 characters, and verify line height with real copy at desktop and mobile widths.

item.title: Balancing Microphone Distance, Polar Patterns, and Proximity Effect
item.description: Test cardioid dynamics and condensers at 10 to 35 cm, match vocal levels, and measure bass and plosive peaks to choose a repeatable placement.

item.title: Structuring Long-Term Project Notes in Portable Plain-Text Markdown
item.description: Archive studio projects with six frontmatter fields, ISO dates, relative image links, and a flat index you can verify in a 10-minute migration drill.

item.title: Measuring Chair Height, Monitor Angle, and Wrist Alignment for Long Sessions
item.description: Use a tape measure to set chair height, seat pan clearance, and monitor position, then check elbow angle and near-neutral wrists while typing.

item.title: Understanding Kelvin Color Temperature and Mixed-Light White Balance
item.description: Balance daylight, tungsten, and LED spill with gray-card readings, Kelvin and tint adjustments, and a three-code RGB tolerance for neutral subjects.

item.title: Reading Luminance and RGB Histograms Without Clipping Highlights
item.description: Read luminance and RGB histograms, bracket in one-third-stop steps, and verify raw highlight margins before exposing to the right in the studio.

item.title: How Focal Length and Subject Distance Change Perspective Compression
item.description: Match framing at 35mm, 50mm, and 85mm, then use measured camera and backdrop distances to predict how large background details will look in studio photos.
